_note: Trial counts recorded in the original project's ledgers before this repository existed. A stage that deflates against its ledger adds `prior_trials` to the rows in the local ledger, so a fresh reproduction deflates against the same count the published report did. Counts were read from the original SQLite ledgers; nothing here is estimated.

operational_db.file: data/db/db.sqlite (the original live system's database), table experiments
operational_db.ids_missing: 1-2, 5-22, 107-120, 169-178 (44 ids): allocated (AUTOINCREMENT) and later removed; recalled by the author as exploratory experiments, configurations not kept

s8-null-baselines.note: The same 24-configuration scan was run three times; the published null_baselines.json (n_trials=72) came from the third run, so a fresh run starts from 48 prior trials.

mn_rv_phase1.note: Experiment ids 3-1730 are missing from the original research ledger (1728 ids, allocated by AUTOINCREMENT and later removed). The author recalls them as exploratory experiments trying different things, removed to save time; their configurations were not kept, so they are not counted here. Counts in this file are therefore lower bounds. The runner refuses to log into a non-empty prefix, so a reproduction counts one run.
